command:
set -e
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin
B=/var/mobile/macws_r008_preinstall_20261018/libmachook-clean
mkdir -p "$B"
cp -p /var/jb/usr/macOS/lib/libmachook.dylib "$B/"
cp -p /var/jb/usr/macOS/lib/libmachook_arm64.dylib "$B/"
FAT=/var/tmp/libmachook-165.dylib
LIB=/var/jb/usr/macOS/lib/libmachook.dylib
LIB64=/var/jb/usr/macOS/lib/libmachook_arm64.dylib
ENT=/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/entitlements.plist
python3 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/set_macos_version.py "$FAT"
T1="${LIB}.sdk165-new.$$"; T2="${LIB64}.sdk165-new.$$"
lipo "$FAT" -thin arm64e -output "$T1"
lipo "$FAT" -thin arm64 -output "$T2"
chmod 755 "$T1" "$T2"
ldid -S"$ENT" -M "$T1"; ldid -S"$ENT" -M "$T1"
ldid -S"$ENT" -M "$T2"; ldid -S"$ENT" -M "$T2"
rm -f "$LIB" "$LIB64"
mv "$T1" "$LIB"; mv "$T2" "$LIB64"
for d in /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib; do
  rm -f "$d/libmachook.dylib" "$d/libmachook_arm64.dylib"
  cp -p "$LIB" "$d/libmachook.dylib"
  cp -p "$LIB64" "$d/libmachook_arm64.dylib"
done
for f in "$LIB" "$LIB64"; do
  for a in arm64 arm64e; do
    h=$(ldid -arch "$a" -h "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep CDHash= | cut -c8-)
    [ -n "$h" ] && jbctl trustcache add "$h" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    [ -z "$h" ] || jbctl trustcache info 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "$h" || { echo "NOT_TRUSTED $f $a $h"; exit 1; }
  done
done
lipo -info "$LIB"; lipo -info "$LIB64"
sha256sum "$LIB" "$LIB64"
echo LIB165_DEPLOY_RC=0
